video.title: AI欧腐《七号救援：从对头到烈焰/Rescue 7: From Rivals to Flames》
video.desc:
测试打码能不能行
Everyone in the city knows that Fire Captain Lucian and I can’t stand each other. But when a hotel inferno nearly kills me, Lucian fights to bring me back—and the tears in his eyes reveal something neither of us is ready to face. Before I can make sense of it, headquarters forces us to lead Rescue 7 together. Now we share the same missions, the same vehicle, and even the same dorm room. I tell myself the heat between us is nothing but rivalry. Then I find a photograph from five years ago and become convinced that Lucian has always been in love with our medic, Adele. I’m wrong. Lucian didn’t fall for her that day. He fell for me. Now every rescue puts my life in his hands, every fight pulls us closer, and I’m beginning to realize that the man I’ve spent years trying to defeat may be the one man I can’t bear to lose.

全城都知道，消防队长 Lucian 和我水火不容。可一场酒店大火差点要了我的命，是 Lucian 拼死把我从鬼门关拉回来——他眼中那抹泪光，暴露了一些我们都还没准备好面对的东西。我还没来得及想明白，总部就强行把我俩一起塞进了"七号救援队"。从此我们执行同一场任务，坐同一辆车，甚至住进了同一个宿舍。我一直告诉自己，我们之间那股火花不过是竞争而已。直到我翻出一张五年前的照片，笃定 Lucian 一直爱着我们队里的随队医护 Adele。可我错了。那一天，Lucian 爱上的根本不是她。他爱上的是我。如今，每一次救援都把我的命交到他手里，每一次争执都把我们拉得更近，而我也渐渐明白——这个我拼了这么多年要打败的男人，或许才是我最无法承受失去的那个人。
